items.title: AWS Lambda now supports orchestrating MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions
items.blurb: Today, AWS announces a developer preview of a new extension for orchestrating Lambda MicroVMs with Lambda durable functions . The extension adds durable operations for running work on MicroVMs and managing their lifecycle.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni now integrates with PagerDuty
items.blurb: Amazon CloudWatch Omni alerts can now automatically create PagerDuty incidents, so notifications flow directly into your existing incident management workflows.

items.title: Amazon EC2 M8g instances are now available in Israel (Tel Aviv)
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M8g instances are available in the Israel (Tel Aviv) region.

items.title: Amazon EC2 M9gd instances are now available in Asia Pacific (Seoul)
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) M9gd instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Seoul) region.

items.title: Amazon EC2 C9gd instances now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9gd instances are available in the Europe (Ireland, Spain) regions.

items.title: Amazon EC2 C9g instances are now available in additional regions
items.blurb: Starting today, Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (Amazon EC2) C9g instances are available in the Asia Pacific (Sydney), Europe (Ireland, Spain), and South America (São Paulo) regions.

items.title: Recap of Microsoft Ignite 2026: Copilot as the Work OS and Agent Governance
items.blurb: At Ignite 2026, Microsoft positioned Copilot as the operating system for work and extended agent identity, governance, and cost controls across Azure, Foundry, Entra, and Defender.
